mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Harriet Park with a temperature of 44 degrees. You can view the moon in its first quarter phase tonight, and the ISS will be visible tomorrow morning at 5:39 AM, rising over Mount Horeb and moving toward the Madison area, reaching high in the sky. The overnight low will hit 34 degrees with no rain expected.

The Verona Police Department reported an incident from last Thursday involving the arrest of a school bus driver for operating while impaired. Officers stopped the bus near Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace after receiving reports of dangerous driving. No injuries occurred, and officials are investigating a potential collision with a traffic sign.

There is plenty to do in our community. Catch live music today at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol Square or live music at Paddy Mac's.
Regarding the incident from last Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after responding to reports of erratic driving.
Today is the perfect day to stop by Culver's for the OREO REESE'S Cheesecake flavor of the day. The store is currently open and will be serving guests until 10:30 PM tonight.
